'''Bili Adarra''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident.

== Appearance ==
He is almost as wide as [[Perrin Aybara]] and a hand shorter.{{Ref/book|11|26}} He is young.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Bili Adarra}}

== History ==
He is a distance cousin of Perrin, one of the few living relatives he has left.{{Ref/book|11|26}}

== Activities ==
He accompanies Perrin into [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]]. He goes through the aqueduct to enter the town of [[Malden]] before Perrin begins his attack.{{Ref/book|11|26}}
